name: magnetic-cursor-bubble
title: Magnetic Cursor Bubble
description: A liquid bubble node that follows pointer coordinates with fluid velocity lag and viscoelastic stretch.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Fluid Bubble Lag Tracking: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
